description: This file defines a CameraController actor in Swift, which manages camera and microphone access, captures photos and videos, handles permissions, enumerates camera devices, and performs related processing such as transcoding videos. It includes error handling, device discovery, and asynchronous workflows for media capture.

classes.name: PhotoCaptureDelegate
classes.description: Delegate handling photo capture callbacks, including processing captured photo data and errors.

classes.name: MovieFileDelegate
classes.description: Delegate handling video recording callbacks, including processing the finish recording event and errors.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Asynchronously captures a photo, processes it, and returns formatted image data including base64 encoding, dimensions, and the image format.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a short video clip, transcoding it to MP4 if necessary, and returns the video data with metadata including duration and audio presence.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Enumerates available video capture devices and returns their information.
